species.name: Jellyfish
mustRead: translucent domed bell
long trailing tentacles hanging far below
frilled oral arms under the centre of the bell
species.note: Generic name read as a representative scyphozoan jellyfish. Tentacle length dominates the profile, making it much taller than wide.

species.name: Sea Urchin
mustRead: spherical test bristling with long straight spines
five-part radial pattern under the spines

species.name: Sea Cucumber
mustRead: soft sagging sausage body
ring of branched feeding tentacles at the mouth end
rows of stubby tube feet along the underside

species.name: Sand Dollar
mustRead: flat circular disc like a coin
five-petal flower pattern on the upper face
fine velvety spine fuzz on a living one
species.note: Radial and wafer-thin - only reads face-on; a true side profile is a featureless sliver.

species.name: Sea Anemone
mustRead: squat column trunk fixed to rock by a basal disc
dense crown of soft waving tentacles
central mouth in the middle of the tentacle ring

species.name: Cold-Water Coral
mustRead: branching bone-white tree-like colony
cup-shaped polyps at the branch tips
species.note: no algae symbionts, so it is white/pale pink - never the tropical rainbow colours

species.name: Brittle Star
mustRead: tiny central disc
five snaky whip arms many times longer than the disc is wide
species.note: arms are thin and flexible and clearly set off from the disc - not the thick tapering arms of a starfish

species.name: Coral
mustRead: branching stony colony
surface covered in tiny cup-shaped polyps
rough calcified texture
species.note: generic name - drawn as a representative branching stony coral colony

species.name: Portuguese Man-of-War
mustRead: gas-filled blue-violet float with a crimped sail crest on top
curtain of extremely long trailing stinging tentacles
species.note: not a jellyfish and has no bell - it is a float on the surface with everything hanging beneath, so it is far taller than wide

species.name: Comb Jelly
mustRead: eight vertical rows of beating comb plates shimmering in rainbow light
transparent oval jelly body with no stinging tentacles
species.note: not a jellyfish - no bell and no stinging trailing tentacles, just the eight comb rows

species.name: Deep-Water Coral
mustRead: pale branching thicket with no algal colour
cup polyps opening at the branch tips
species.note: generic name - drawn as a Lophelia-type white branching colony, not a tropical reef head
